items.text:
A 22 minute game about an English man feeling sorry for himself, getting drunk, and feeling more sorry for himself. Game will essentially play itself if you don't touch it.

While it's a relatively early indie game and the tools weren't quite there yet at the time, there's just not anything to it, be it gameplay or story, unless you really want to get in the mind of a 27 year old white guy upset that he didn't get to have sex with a 20 year old Japanese girl.
items.text_zh:
一款22分钟的游戏，讲的是一个英国男人自怨自艾、喝醉，然后更加自怨自艾。如果你不碰它，游戏基本上会自己玩下去。

虽然这是一款相对早期的独立游戏，当时工具也还不够成熟，但它实在没什么内容，无论是玩法还是故事，除非你真的想进入一个27岁白人男性的内心，他因为没能和一个20岁的日本女孩发生性关系而耿耿于怀。

items.text: Это короткая зарисовка, показывающая кусок чужой жизни, пройти можно, но нет смысла тратить сотку и время, если можно взять/пройти за эти деньги что-то получше (хотя бы пройтись по тегу "Короткая"). Интересных событий нет, нормальной интерактивности нет. Заботьтесь о себе, берите и играйте в самое лучшее и интересное. В Стиме очень много игр, заботьтесь о лучших из них, не тратьте время на средние. И курение покоробило. Была мысль, что сейчас будет что-то внезапное, но нет.

items.text: Die Verabredung taucht nicht auf und Du sitzt mit Selbstzweifel am Tisch. Das wünscht sich doch jeder bzw. wollte das schon immer mal spielen. Naja, Spielen ist zu hoch gegriffen. Man kann im Sitzen auf die Uhr sehen, die Hände bewegen, Brot essen, Wein trinken, sich umsehen, etc. Vor allem dem eigenem Gejammer lauschen. Kunst beiseite, Spaß sieht anders aus. Erinnert alles sehr an deutsches Kino, entweder Drama oder flacher Humor. Letzteres fehlt hier ja komplett! Wer noch nicht versetzt wurde bzw. noch keine Freundin hatte und das Erleben möchte, sollte zugreifen. Der Rest kann sich das sparen, für den Preis wird da zu wenig geboten.
items.text_zh: 约会对象没有出现，而你带着自我怀疑坐在桌边。这难道不是每个人都想要的吗，或者说一直都想玩玩的吗。算了，说“玩”都算抬举了。你可以坐着看表、动动手、吃面包、喝葡萄酒、四处张望等等。尤其是听自己发牢骚。撇开艺术不谈，乐趣可不是这样的。这一切都让人想起德国电影，要么是剧情片，要么是肤浅的幽默。而后者在这里完全缺失！还没被甩过、或者还没交过女朋友、又想体验一下的人，应该入手。其余的人可以省了，这个价格给的东西太少了。

items.text:
I can't remember when I got this game, but it was closer to when it came out than to now. Pretty sure it was around the time Heavy Rain came out and I didn't have a PS3 and I thought "hey this is a novel experiment I should try this out." It wasn't really much back then and I don't think it aged well at all. It's absurdly short and I've heard people back then say $5 is a bit overpriced for a "demo" like this. Nowadays I don't think people care that much about throwing $5 away to play ♥♥♥♥♥♥ video games but ♥♥♥♥ it.

So you play as the "subconscious" of Julian Luxemburg, an Englishman office worker who seems posh but is a 27 year old bachelor in a run down apartment trying to get laid. More specifically your co-worker set you up with a Japanese girl named Meiko who... hasn't arrived. The "gameplay" is uh... various prompts appear on screen, you press a prompt and Julian does something. That's pretty much it. Press Q to look at the clock. Press N to eat the bread. So on. It's a very narrative driven game where you're not really supposed to play it but rather you're supposed to just sit there and listen to the ramblings of a loner, and the quality of writing is just you'd expect from that kind of melodramatic premise. There are three "parts" to the game and the only character you see is Julian, as (spoiler) his date never really shows up anyway, so he gets drunk on two or three glasses of wine and then runs off to the club his co-workers party at to try and find her.

In my honest to God opinion Julian seems like a stupid young man who bends easily to expectation. His motives are kind of pathetic. He practices reciting poetry to himself in hopes to impress her (even though his kitchen is a mess) among other things but in his inner monologue you barely don't hear much about his thoughts on HER as a person or a character because he isn't so much into the whole relationship aspect as he is getting laid and living the same kind of life his peers are. In other words he's in it exclusively for that sweet Asian ♥♥♥♥♥, and living in the comformity of actually getting ♥♥♥♥♥. I'd go as far as to call him an incel but that might be a bit mean on my part plus I'm just not sure he meets the criteria. The ingrediants are there, it just hasn't baked yet. I mean if you're going after a girl just to get your ♥♥♥♥ wet and not to pursue a relationship then just rent a prostitute or something, mate.

So this was an interesting project in 2011 or so but it's lackluster now. Telltale is bankrupt now and narrative games are kind of the status quo now. This one isn't very quality. 

It's not even a good "eating a fancy dinner alone in your apartment" simulator. Sorry.

我记不清是什么时候拿到这款游戏的，但比起现在，那更接近它刚发售的时候。很确定大概是在《暴雨》问世前后，我当时没有PS3，心想“嘿，这是个新奇的实验，我应该试试。”那时候它其实没多少内容，而且我觉得它完全没经受住时间的考验。它短得离谱，我听说当时有人说，为这样一个“demo”花5美元有点太贵了。如今我觉得人们不太在乎扔5美元去玩♥♥♥♥♥♥电子游戏，但♥♥♥♥它吧。

所以你扮演的是朱利安·卢森堡的“潜意识”，一个英国办公室职员，看起来很有派头，其实是个27岁的单身汉，住在破旧的公寓里，一心想上床。更具体地说，你的同事给你安排了一个叫美子的日本女孩，可她……还没到。“玩法”呃……屏幕上会出现各种提示，你按一个提示，朱利安就做点什么。差不多就这样。按Q看时钟。按N吃面包。诸如此类。这是一款非常叙事驱动的游戏，你其实不该去“玩”它，而应该就坐在那里听一个孤独者的絮叨，而写作质量正如你对那种情节剧式前提所能预料的那样。游戏有三个“部分”，你唯一看到的角色就是朱利安，因为（剧透）他的约会对象根本没出现，于是他喝了两三杯葡萄酒就醉了，然后跑去他同事们聚会的俱乐部找她。

凭我发自内心的看法，朱利安看起来像个愚蠢的年轻人，很容易屈从于他人的期望。他的动机有点可悲。他练习对自己朗诵诗歌，希望能打动她（尽管他的厨房一团糟），诸如此类，但在他的内心独白里，你几乎听不到多少他把她当作一个人或一个角色来看待的想法，因为他并不那么在意恋爱关系本身，他在意的是上床，以及过上和他同龄人一样的生活。换句话说，他参与这件事完全是为了那甜美的亚洲♥♥♥♥♥，以及活在真正能♥♥♥♥♥的从众生活里。我甚至想称他为incel，但这么说可能对我而言有点刻薄，而且我也不确定他是否符合标准。成分都在那儿了，只是还没烤熟。我的意思是，如果你追一个女孩只是为了把你的♥♥♥♥弄湿，而不是为了发展一段关系，那干脆去租个妓女什么的吧，老兄。

所以这在2011年前后是个有趣的项目，但现在它很平庸。Telltale现在破产了，叙事游戏如今差不多成了常态。这一款质量不怎么样。

它甚至都不是一个好的“独自在公寓里吃一顿精致晚餐”模拟器。抱歉。

This is supposed to be an artsy-fartsy game, I can see that... Honestly though, it's hardly anything I'd consider calling art (considering the game's poor graphics), and I wouldn't go as far as calling it a "game". The plot of the game is simple [**SPOILER ALERT**: You play a guy who set up a dinner date with some japanese girl. Just by listening to the guys dialogue, apparently the main character cares more about getting laid than anything else. But then he learns he got stood up on his date, eats alone, get pissed off, complains alot, then leaves his apartment drunk.] There is no objective! All you do is control his hands. And what do you do with your hands? Very simple... You eat, smoke, make gestures, and drink. Nothing you do can change the outcome of the game, you don't make any differences, your actions are so insignificant I feel like I waste my time everytime I turn on the "game". And the main character's rambling makes me feel like I'm working as a counselor, I don't want to work! I want to play a fun game!!! THIS ISN'T FUN!!!! I'd give this game a rating of:

0.5/10 - Counselor Simulator

This doesn't deserve to exist!

这应该是一款装腔作势的艺术游戏，我看得出来……不过说实话，考虑到这游戏糟糕的画面，它几乎算不上我能称之为艺术的东西，我也不会称它为“游戏”。游戏剧情很简单[**剧透警告**：你扮演一个和某个日本女孩约好共进晚餐的家伙。光听这家伙的对话，显然主角比起其他任何事都更在乎上床。但后来他得知自己在约会中被放了鸽子，独自吃饭，怒火中烧，抱怨个不停，然后醉醺醺地离开了公寓。]没有任何目标！你所能做的就是控制他的双手。那用双手做什么呢？非常简单……你吃东西、抽烟、做手势、喝酒。你所做的一切都无法改变游戏的结局，你造不成任何影响，你的行为如此微不足道，以至于我每次打开这个“游戏”都觉得自己在浪费时间。而且主角的絮絮叨叨让我觉得自己像是在当心理咨询师，我不想工作！我想玩一款有趣的游戏！！！这不好玩！！！！我会给这款游戏评分：

这东西不配存在！

items.text:
This was an experience really destroyed by having any expectations and paying money.

I went into it really happy to see something like this, but man did it fall short. It is about 15 minutes long and there's basically nothing to do or affect. The subject matter was so banal that I spent the whole time waiting for a breaththrough that just doesn't happen.

I think it is also misleading by saying you "become the subconscious" of the main character. Because you don't, you just hear it, and the only think you control is some conscious decision making (like pouring wine) and order of operations. In that way, it's a kind of interesting slightly experimental movie, but it's far from any roleplay possibilities offered by using a videogame over a short film.

I did like a lot of the visual design. The objects were well designed and the icons conveyed their points well while working with the theme. The acting was good.

I really wanted to like it. I think it's an interesting portfolio piece for all involved. But it's not worth paying for.
items.text_zh:
这本来是一次被任何期望和花钱彻底毁掉的体验。

我进去的时候真的很高兴能看到这样的东西，但天哪，它差得太远了。它大约15分钟长，基本上没有什么可做或可影响的。题材如此平庸，以至于我全程都在等待一个根本不会发生的突破。

我觉得说你会“成为主角的潜意识”也是误导。因为你并没有，你只是听到它，你唯一能控制的就是一些有意识的决策（比如倒酒）和操作顺序。那样的话，它算是一种有点意思、略微实验性的电影，但远不及使用电子游戏而非短片所能提供的任何角色扮演可能性。

我确实喜欢很多视觉设计。物品设计得很好，图标在配合主题的同时很好地传达了它们的含义。表演也不错。

我真的很想喜欢它。我认为对所有参与者来说，这是一件有趣的 portfolio 作品。但它不值得花钱。

This game is the biggest pile of pretentious tripe I've ever played, this is coming from someone who's favourite experience from a video game was Dear Esther.

Say what you like about Dear Esther but the point of it was that it was following the inner thoughts of a suicidally depressed man as we got some insight on loss, pain, depression and regret and what does Dinner Date offer us? The Inner thoughts of a boring, pretentious pillock, who's whining because nobody wants to bugger him.

I'm serious, this whole game is just a man, sat at a table, whining because he can't get laid and the worst part is that he has no redeeming qualities. He's racist, narcissistic, boring and full of crap. There is NOTHING worth investing yourself in, it's not even funny boring, it's just boring.

You could honestly get the same experience by going to your kitchen table and sitting there for twenty or so minutes, like you're waiting for a date, listening to a pod cast on the colour baige the entire time. There, you've played Dinner Date, except you can actually eat the food and turn off the podcast.

So, why haven't I spoken about the gameplay? Because there is none! Again, Dear Esther, you can walk around and look at stuff, listen to the monologue or enjoy the scenery. Here, there's NOTHING! You can interact with things, sure but only when the game tells you that it's okay to, otherwise you just hover your hand over it, like you're thinking about doing it. The game even tells you that you aren't in control and you're the character's subconscious, making this no more of a game than one of those College Humour POV videos, except those are funny and often relatable, whereas this is just garbage.

You have dozens of options presented to you, whilst you listen to the insightful inner thoughts of the loathesome protagonist and all that I was able to do was dip bread into a sauce and eat it. Although, I will say that I did find one thing in common with this guy, we were both incredibly bored and clock watching, throughout the experience.

The visuals look like ♥♥♥♥, I'm by no means a graphics snob but if you're going to force us to look at something for half an hour at least make it look realistic/nice or at least give it its own style like Facade. But no, this looks like a PS2 game that has gone through a dishwasher, it looks really shoddy.

The final thing I have to say is that everything about this game is still pretentious, despite the fact that it offers NOTHING, it acts like it's high art. It constantly has the div recite poetry with classical music playing in the background, whilst he goes on about how Japanese girls can't hold their liquor and how he can't wait for his date to show up so he can shag her. Bugger off Dinner Date, just bugger off.

During the hit list- I mean... credits, my eyes were drawn to the list of the cast and crew and bugger me backwards... 
Try thinking up the most pretentious pseudonym you can, make it sound french and artsy like: Don Panthane Do Blur or some ♥♥♥♥ like that. Because the credits is full of those names, it's so full of it.

Don't buy this. If I had a physical copy of this game, I would've taken it out back and pissed on it. Screw this game!
items.text_zh:
这款游戏是我玩过的最自命不凡的一堆废话，这话出自一个最喜欢的电子游戏体验是《亲爱的艾丝特》的人之口。

关于《亲爱的艾丝特》，你爱怎么说就怎么说，但它的重点在于，它跟随的是一个有自杀倾向的抑郁症男人的内心想法，让我们对失落、痛苦、抑郁和悔恨有所洞察，而《晚餐约会》给了我们什么？一个无聊、自命不凡的蠢货的内心想法，他因为没人愿意操他而抱怨。

我是认真的，整个游戏就是一个男人，坐在桌边，因为上不了床而抱怨，最糟糕的是他没有任何可取之处。他种族歧视、自恋、无聊、满嘴胡扯。没有任何值得你投入的东西，它甚至不是那种有趣的无聊，它就是无聊。

老实说，你只要走到厨房餐桌旁，在那儿坐上二十分钟左右，就像你在等约会一样，全程听一个关于米色这种颜色的播客，就能获得同样的体验。好了，你已经玩过《晚餐约会》了，只不过你还能真的吃掉食物，还能关掉播客。

那么，我为什么没谈玩法？因为根本没有！再说一次，《亲爱的艾丝特》，你可以四处走动、看看东西、听独白或欣赏风景。而这里，什么都没有！你可以和东西互动，没错，但只有在游戏告诉你现在可以的时候，否则你只能把手悬停在上面，就像你在考虑要不要动手一样。游戏甚至告诉你，你并不在掌控之中，你是角色的潜意识，这让它比那些大学幽默频道的POV视频都更像不上一款游戏，只不过那些视频很好笑而且常常让人有共鸣，而这个只是垃圾。

在你听着那可憎主角富有洞见的内心想法时，有几十个选项摆在你面前，而我能做的只是把面包蘸进酱里然后吃掉。不过，我得说，我确实和这家伙找到了一个共同点，在整个体验过程中，我们俩都无聊透顶，一直盯着钟看。

画面看起来像♥♥♥♥，我绝不是个画面势利眼，但如果你要强迫我们盯着某个东西看半个小时，至少让它看起来真实/好看，或者至少像《Facade》那样有自己的风格。但没有，这看起来像一款被放进洗碗机洗过的PS2游戏，看起来真的很劣质。

我最后要说的是，这款游戏的一切仍然自命不凡，尽管它什么都没提供，却表现得像高雅艺术一样。它不断让那个蠢货背诵诗歌，背景放着古典音乐，同时他还在大谈日本女孩酒量不行，以及他等不及约会对象出现好跟她上床。滚蛋吧《晚餐约会》，赶紧滚蛋。

在击杀名单——我是说……制作人员名单里，我的目光被演员和工作人员名单吸引，我了个去……
试着想出一个你能想到的最自命不凡的假名，让它听起来像法语、有艺术感，比如：Don Panthane Do Blur之类的♥♥♥♥。因为制作人员名单里全是这种名字，太装了。

别买这个。如果我有一份这款游戏的实体拷贝，我会把它拿到后院，往上面撒尿。去你的这款游戏！

items.text:
Possibly the dryest 'game' I've ever played. You sit at a table waiting for your date to show up, (SPOILERS) she never shows up. The game lures you into thinking it's going to be like surgeon simulator, explaining hand controls using 'q w e r' for the movement of each finger, and 'g' for the thumb. You are then disappointingly backhanded when you instead are greeted with the option to press various keys in order to perform movements/action, all with the aim to waste enough time for more key options to become available, each duller than the last - This functionality saps any potential morsel of comedy, unlike an actual 'key per finger' style, where there are morsels to be found.

First, you are limited to tapping your fingers on the table, and looking up at the clock. Then it really gets crazy when the option to eat some bread appears. From thereout you will continue to pointlessly press buttons and observe the mundane animation. My favorite part has to be where you are granted the option to dip your bread into the soup you've been stirring for 10 minutes.

The game ends when your character staggers out of the apartment after a few glasses of wine, presumably to perform some kind of aggressive crime against the elusive date. This means you basically miss the most exciting part of the protagonists evening.

1/10. There is no challenge, no excitement, and no respite from the ball-achingly dull key tapping. Only play this game if someone has a gun to your head.
items.text_zh:
可能是我玩过的最枯燥的“游戏”。你坐在桌边等你的约会对象出现，（剧透）她从未出现。游戏引诱你以为它会像《外科医生模拟器》那样，用“q w e r”来解释每根手指的运动，用“g”来解释拇指。然后你失望地被反手一击，因为你反而看到的是按各种键来执行动作/行为的选项，全都为了消磨足够的时间让更多按键选项出现，每一个都比上一个更无聊——这种功能榨干了任何一丝喜剧潜力，不像真正的“每根手指一个键”风格，那种风格里还能找到些笑料。

首先，你只能敲桌子上的手指，抬头看钟。然后真正疯狂的是吃面包的选项出现了。从那时起，你会继续毫无意义地按按钮，观察平淡的动画。我最喜欢的部分必须是你可以选择把面包蘸进你已经搅拌了10分钟的汤里。

游戏在你喝了几杯酒后摇摇晃晃地走出公寓时结束，大概是要对那个难以捉摸的约会对象实施某种暴力犯罪。这意味着你基本上错过了主角晚上最激动人心的部分。

1/10。没有挑战，没有兴奋，也没有从蛋疼般无聊的按键敲击中解脱。只有在有人拿枪指着你头的时候才玩这个游戏。

"[i]Мы живём в равнодушном мире. Нас окружают десятки людей, знакомые, коллеги, друзья, но мы одиноки. Можно долго терпеть, находя спасение в книгах, фильмах, аниме, фантазиях и надеждах...[/i]" (О. Хироя, [b]"GANTZ"[/b])

Как быстро первая любовь превращается из незабываемого романтического приключения в бесконечную череду влюблённостей и сексуальных связей, нивелирующих изначально светлое и необыкновенное чувство? Быть может, это единственный вопрос, не взволновавший молодого клерка [i]Джулиана Люксембурга[/i] в предвкушении новой японской подружки, которая по какой-то причине задерживается... Куда она запропастилась?

[b][u]Die Leiden des jungen Werthers[/u][/b]
Однако вопросы, которыми задаётся протагонист меркнут, на фоне тех, коими озадачен изумлённый игрок. Что это такое? Затянувшаяся кат-сцена? Где нормальный игровой процесс?! Неужели это очередная претенциозная поделка в духе [url=store.steampowered.com/app/203810/?l=russian]"Dear Esther"[/url]?! И если эти особенности вызвали у вас справедливое негодование или, тем паче, тоску по классическим адвенчурам, то лучше пройти мимо, закрыв рекомендацию, ибо остальная её часть посвящается тем, кто предпочитает подобные эксперименты.

Итак, не стоит делать поспешных выводов: с "Dear Esther" (напомню, что [url=http://www.moddb.com/mods/dear-esther]оригинальный мод[/url] вышел ещё в 2008 году) игру роднит разве что слабая интерактивность и погружение во внутренний мир главного героя (увы, графическое исполнение проекта [b]Stout Games[/b] оставляет желать лучшего). Кстати, в игровом описании нет ошибки: за примерно 25 минут вы скорее всего не только пройдёте эту игру (перформанс, если угодно), но и услышите все возможные реплики [i]Джулиана[/i] (не в пример проекту [b]The Chinese Room[/b]).

Перед игроком раскрывается история внутренних переживаний [i]Джулиана[/i], в которой вы выступаете в качестве его бессознательного. Другими словами, речь идёт о языке тела, об управлении жестами и вниманием главного героя посредством нескольких клавиш (геймпад не поддерживается), которые открывают те или иные мысленные реплики его эго (в отличие от игр [b]Tale of Tales[/b] всё это подано на бытовом уровне, без метафор), сохраняя призрачный налёт нелинейности¹.

Оригинально? Возможно. Но, к сожалению, история о томительном ожидании сексуальной партнёрши, приправленная цитатами из [url=dlib.rsl.ru/viewer/01004864108#?page=21]"Дон[/url] [url=dlib.rsl.ru/viewer/01004864112#?page=11]Жуана"[/url] [url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD,_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B6_%D0%93%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD]Дж. Г. Байрона[/url] и рефлексией главного героя, едва ли способна тягаться с творчеством [url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8,_%D0%A5%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B8]Х. Мураками[/url] и [url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%8C%D1%8E%D1%8D%D0%BD,_%D0%98%D1%8D%D0%BD]И. Р. Макьюэна[/url]. Более того, будь она написана в прозе или снята на видео в формате короткометражного фильма, то скорее всего, осталась бы вечно пылиться на специализированных сайтах для начинающих писателей или сгинула под тоннами более увлекательных роликов на [b]YouTube[/b]. С другой стороны, карикатурное отражение одиночества современного интеллигента и ненавязчивое рассуждение о душевной замкнутости в духе уэльбековской философии в целом сглаживают впечатления от прохождения.

Таким образом, интерактивный формат вкупе с простой и понятной подачей всё же сыграли на руку автору идеи Йеруну Д. Стауту и смогли оттеснить часть критики в сторону проекта благодаря новаторству, уютной романтической атмосфере, настроение которой, не в последнюю очередь, задаёт приятное музыкальное сопровождение. И хотя цена в полтора раза ниже, чем у той же "Dear Esther", рекомендую покупать игру на распродаже.

[b][u]Friend Zone[/u][/b]
Типичная история о безответном чувстве. В ком-то пробудит забытые надежды, у кого-то вызовет отвращение или тоску по прошлому, а иным подарит несколько минут искренней радости и душевной теплоты... items.text_zh:
"[i]我们生活在一个冷漠的世界里。我们周围有几十个人，熟人、同事、朋友，但我们却是孤独的。我们梦想着去爱和被爱，却太自私，除了自己谁也不关心……我们的生活被按钟点安排得满满当当：我们工作，然后回家，坐着，呆呆地盯着舒适地嘟囔着的电视机，吃，喝，匆匆忙忙地做爱……从这样的世界里想要逃离。可以长久地忍耐，在书籍、电影、动漫、幻想和希望中寻找救赎……[/i]"（奥·广哉，[b]《GANTZ》[/b]）

初恋是如何迅速地从一个难忘的浪漫冒险变成一连串无尽的恋情和性关系，从而抹平了那最初光明而非凡的情感？也许，这是年轻职员[i]朱利安·卢森堡[/i]在期待一位不知为何迟迟不来的新日本女友时，唯一没有为之激动的问题……她跑到哪里去了？

[b][u]Die Leiden des jungen Werthers[/u][/b]
然而，主人公所思考的问题，在惊愕的玩家所困惑的问题面前黯然失色。这是什么？一场拖长的过场动画？正常的游戏流程在哪里？！难道这又是像[url=store.steampowered.com/app/203810/?l=russian]"Dear Esther"[/url]那样一部自命不凡的玩意儿？！如果这些特点引起了您理所当然的愤慨，或者更甚，让您怀念起经典冒险游戏，那最好绕道而行，关掉这篇推荐，因为它的其余部分是为那些偏爱此类实验的人而写的。

那么，不要急于下结论：与"Dear Esther"（提醒一下，[url=http://www.moddb.com/mods/dear-esther]原版模组[/url]早在2008年就发布了）相比，这款游戏与之相似之处大概只有微弱的互动性和对主人公内心世界的沉浸（唉，[b]Stout Games[/b]项目的画面表现实在不敢恭维）。顺便说一句，游戏描述里没有错：大约25分钟内，您很可能不仅会通关这款游戏（如果您愿意，也可以称之为表演），还会听到[i]朱利安[/i]所有可能的台词（不像[b]The Chinese Room[/b]的项目）。

在玩家面前展开的是[i]朱利安[/i]内心体验的故事，在其中您扮演的是他的无意识。换句话说，这里说的是身体语言，是通过几个按键（不支持手柄）来操控主人公的手势和注意力，这些按键会触发他自我的某些内心独白（与[b]Tale of Tales[/b]的游戏不同，这一切都是以日常层面呈现的，没有隐喻），同时保留着一层幽灵般的非线性色彩¹。

有创意吗？也许吧。但遗憾的是，这个关于苦等性伴侣的故事，虽然点缀着[url=dlib.rsl.ru/viewer/01004864108#?page=21]"唐[/url] [url=dlib.rsl.ru/viewer/01004864112#?page=11]璜"[/url][url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD,_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B6_%D0%93%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD]拜伦[/url]的引文和主人公的反思，却几乎无法与[url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8,_%D0%A5%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B8]村上春树[/url]和[url=ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%8C%D1%8E%D1%8D%D0%BD,_%D0%98%D1%8D%D0%BD]伊恩·麦克尤恩[/url]的作品相提并论。此外，如果它是用散文写成的，或者拍成短片视频，那么很可能只会永远尘封在面向新手作家的专门网站上，或者淹没在[b]YouTube[/b]上成吨更有趣的视频之下。另一方面，对现代知识分子孤独的漫画式反映，以及对内心封闭的不着痕迹的思考——颇有韦勒贝克哲学之风——总体上还是缓和了通关后的观感。

因此，互动形式加上简单易懂的呈现方式，终究还是帮了创意作者耶伦·D·斯托特一把，并凭借其创新性、温馨浪漫的氛围（这种氛围的营造，很大程度上要归功于悦耳的音乐伴奏），将一部分批评声从项目上引开。尽管价格比"Dear Esther"便宜一半，我还是建议在打折时购买这款游戏。

Basically, this is not a game, but rather a kind of interactive arthouse movie. That's why I don't recommend it.

You play the game from the perspective of a man who is waiting for his date but is obviously stood up by her, so while you eat the food you've cooked yourself, get involuntarily drunk (because you're now drinking the wine alone) and smoke a frustrating cigarette, you're haunted by your own thoughts.

That's all this experience offers. After just under 30 minutes, it's over and you can't shake the feeling that you could have made better use of those 30 minutes in any other way. Especially if you have already been transferred in real life, there is nothing new here. Don't buy it yourself, but wait for an indie bundle to come along. And then think twice if you don't have something better to do.

------         

Im Grunde handelt es sich hier nicht um ein Spiel, sondern eher um eine Art interaktiver Arthouse Film. Deshalb kann ich auch eher abraten.

Man spielt das Spiel aus der Sicht eines Mannes, der auf seine Verabredung wartet, aber offenkundig von ihr versetzt wird, Während man also das selbstgekochte Essen selbst auffuttert, sich unfreiwillig besäuft (da man den Wein jetzt allein trinkt) und eine Frustzigarette raucht wird man von den eigenen Gedanken verfolgt.

Mehr bietet dieses Erlebnis nicht. Nach knapp 30 Min ist es vorbei und man wird das Gefühl nicht los, die 30 Min in jedem Fall anders besser genutzt zu haben. Speziell wenn man selbst schon mal im Real Life versetzt worden ist, bietet sich einem hier nichts neues. Nicht selbst kaufen, sondern darauf warten, dass es einem Indie Bundle beiligt. Und auch dann zweimal überlegen, ob man nicht etwas besseres zu tun hat.

Usually I really love artistic games and I really like the idea for this game. I also rarely wish I could refund a game I've bought from Steam, even if I dislike it. This is not one of those times. 2.99 is actually way too much for such a lack of game.

Positive things first:
 - I actually did like the monologue and felt badly for the character, pathetic as he was. However, my dislike for the character rose as I realized that my actions did not have any effect on him.
 - ...it's cheap?

Negative things:

 - I don't know about anyone else, but my subconcious desires and fears do have some effect on my life, besides where I look. In fact, that is an incredibly random thing for a "sub-concious" to control. Looking back at the description of the game, I think it should be more evident that the point of the game is not to "play" but to listen. I wouldn't be interested in such a game, but I think they could have avoided a lot of alienation but spelling it out that this was a game like Dear Esther. There is obviously an aundience for this type of game, this really should be described better for this crowd.

 - Again, looking back at the description, I see a lot of "unanswered question" type wonderings, but the game is rather straightforword. Julian does not like his coworkers. He does like Byron. There is no real reason to play after the first "act", because it is all spelled out there. I criticized its lousy gameplay strategy before but now I'm criticizing its storytelling.
   
   Why should I care about Julian? Yes, it sucks that he got stood up, but so what? There is no mystery to him, which is fine in real life, but characters who spend 20 minutes or so talking about themselves should really have something interesting to say. Sure, he likes poetry, but so do a lot of people. And they are probably less insufferable and boring than Julian is. No new information is gathered in each subsequent act and there is no real reason to have the game continue with no new information or insight.

   The game's story got ever-so-slightly more interesting near the end, when someone knocks at the door, and I did feel something at his emotions afterward, but that really doesn't excuse the 20 minutes of boredom proceeding that. Boredom can be used in video games and stories, but it should be rewarded or serve a point.

So, no, I would not recommend this game to anyone. It is not a game, it is not a compelling story, and it isn't even a good sleep aid, since no one could sleep over Julian's whining.

通常我真的很喜欢艺术性游戏，而且我真的很喜欢这个游戏的点子。我也很少希望自己能退款一个从Steam买的游戏，即使我不喜欢它。这次不是那种时候。2.99对于如此缺乏游戏性的东西来说，实际上太贵了。

先说优点：
 - 我其实确实喜欢那段独白，也为这个角色感到难过，尽管他很可悲。然而，当我意识到我的行为对他没有任何影响时，我对这个角色的反感增加了。
 - ……它很便宜？

缺点：

 - 我不知道别人怎么样，但我的潜意识欲望和恐惧确实对我的生活有一些影响，除了我看向哪里。事实上，对于一个“潜意识”来说，控制这个是非常随机的事情。回头看游戏的描述，我觉得应该更明显地表明，这个游戏的重点不是“玩”，而是倾听。我不会对这样的游戏感兴趣，但我认为他们本可以避免很多疏离感，只要明确说明这是一个像《亲爱的艾丝特》那样的游戏。显然这类游戏有受众，这真的应该为这类人群描述得更好。

 - 再次回头看描述，我看到很多“未解问题”式的疑惑，但游戏其实相当直白。朱利安不喜欢他的同事。他确实喜欢拜伦。在第一“幕”之后，没有真正的理由继续玩，因为一切都在那里说明白了。我之前批评过它糟糕的游戏玩法策略，但现在我在批评它的叙事。
   
   我为什么要关心朱利安？是的，他被放鸽子了很糟糕，但那又怎样？他身上没有谜团，这在现实生活中没问题，但一个花20分钟左右谈论自己的角色，真的应该有一些有趣的东西可说。当然，他喜欢诗歌，但很多人也喜欢。而且他们可能没有朱利安那么令人难以忍受和无聊。在随后的每一幕中都没有收集到新信息，也没有真正的理由让游戏在没有新信息或洞见的情况下继续下去。

   游戏的故事在接近结尾时变得稍微有趣了一点，当时有人敲门，之后我确实对他的情绪有所感触，但这真的不能为之前20分钟的无聊开脱。无聊可以在电子游戏和故事中使用，但它应该得到回报或服务于某个目的。

所以，不，我不会向任何人推荐这个游戏。它不是游戏，不是引人入胜的故事，甚至不是好的助眠工具，因为没人能在朱利安的抱怨声中睡着。

The idea this game seems to present is a good one- to subtley influence the main character's actions by acting as their subconscious. Unfortunately the game fails to do any such thing, and makes it so any actions you make have no impact at all on what happens. 

That aside, the most damning thing about this game is that it even plays itself. You can sit and watch the screen and the game will do tiny actions for you, making a significant point about just how insignificant any user input is in this game. In fact, this barely even qualifies as a game. It's more of an "art" piece, if anything. 

To make a long statement short, this isn't worth your money. After playing it I actually wish someone had slipped me a dollar and a half for my time. 0/10, no stars, 0% on Rotten Tomatoes, worst interactive movie of 2011.

items.text:
Dinner Date is a very short indie title about a man waiting for his date to arrive and I ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hated it.

The main reason I hated this game was mainly due to the usual false expectations scenario. Rather than just completely rip this game apart let me explain what I thought the game was going to be, and then what the game actually is.

What I thought Dinner Date was going to be:

Everything I thought this game was going to be came from what people posted about on the internet. Nothing I am writing in this section is what I hoped the game would be, this is what I expected based on others experiences with it. Like I mentioned above, this is a game about a man waiting for his date to arrive at his house. However, I was under the assumption that this would be 1st person, without any narration, and you are completely free to do whatever you want while you wait for the date. You do not know who the date is, or why this man is possibly being stood up. Maybe this is him being dumped, maybe he murdered her, maybe he doesn’t have a date and he’s lonely, we just don’t know. While waiting for your possible date to arrive, you are free to do whatever you want in your apartment. Doing actions will affect the outcome of “The Date”. Maybe you could eat your entire meal before he/she shows up, would that have an effect? Maybe if you drink the whole bottle of wine you will pass out and miss the date entirely, never knowing if the person came by or not. Maybe you could just sit there and wait the entire time, twiddling your thumbs, eagerly watching the clock. Maybe you could just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ kill yourself, the point is what sold me on this game was mystery. Every time I looked into this game online, for whatever reason, the game was completely shrouded in mystery, and this made me want to play the game so badly. I was honestly expecting to play this game multiple times just to see what else I could make happen. There could’ve been so many possibilities, so many outcomes, but as you can guess I ended up being tremendously disappointed.

What Dinner Date actually is:

A monologue. The game is literally just a monologue disguised as a video game. If there are any David Cage fanboys reading this, buy this game right now. NOTHING you do while you “wait” for you date matters. I only played this game once and I went in with the intention of killing my character through alcohol abuse, but even though I am drinking down a glass of wine every 5 seconds, the character doesn’t shut up…even while he is drinking. You are forced to listen to this guy whine and complain and there’s nothing you can do about it. Yeah, there are actions, but they are ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ meaningless. I’m pretty sure if someone smoked 47 cigarettes in a row he would maybe cough a few times in the middle of his ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. The game kept giving me hope that something good would happen. Oh look! He’s getting up! Can I jump out the window? Nope. Can I open my fridge? Nope. Well, can I grab that endless bottle of wine again? Not right now, nope. When I realized that I could just sit back and the game would play itself I decided to stick through to the end, with the hope that maybe something interesting would happen, but of course not. You listen to this guy whine and complain about life for awhile and then that’s it, it just ends. He doesn’t kill himself (sadly), the date never shows up, nothing ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ happens. The best part about the uh experience is the torture is short. My game time for this is 23 minutes and I waiting till the credits ended.

So that’s it, I can’t even recommend this game to people who enjoy monologues, or hearing sad..ish life stories. Rather that waste your time listening to this guys issue’s you could go hang out with your friends, and maybe help them with their problems. I can promise in that situation different outcomes and functionality that makes an impact, I dare you to try and drink as much wine as I did in this game while hearing your friend talk. In other words, real life is more of a video game than Dinner Date.

《晚餐约会》是一款非常简短的独立游戏，讲述一个男人等待他的约会对象到来，而我♥♥♥♥♥♥♥讨厌它。

我讨厌这款游戏的主要原因主要是由于常见的错误期望情景。与其完全把这款游戏撕成碎片，不如让我解释一下我以为这款游戏会是什么样，然后再说明这款游戏实际上是什么样。

我以为《晚餐约会》会是什么样：

我以为这款游戏会是什么样的一切都来自人们在互联网上发布的内容。我在这一部分写的任何东西都不是我希望这款游戏会是什么样，而是我根据其他人对它的体验所期望的。就像我上面提到的，这是一款关于一个男人在家里等待他的约会对象到来的游戏。然而，我当时的假设是这会是第一人称，没有任何旁白，而且在等待约会时你完全可以自由地做任何你想做的事。你不知道约会对象是谁，也不知道这个男人为什么可能被放鸽子。也许这是他被人甩了，也许他杀了她，也许他根本没有约会对象，只是很孤独，我们就是不知道。在等待你可能的约会对象到来时，你可以在你的公寓里自由地做任何你想做的事。做动作会影响“约会”的结果。也许你可以在他/她出现之前吃掉你整顿饭，那会有影响吗？也许如果你喝完整瓶酒，你会昏过去并完全错过约会，永远不知道那个人有没有来过。也许你可以就坐在那里，一直等下去，无聊地转着大拇指，急切地盯着时钟。也许你可以就♥♥♥♥♥♥♥自杀，重点是，这款游戏吸引我的地方就是神秘感。每次我在网上查看这款游戏时，不知为何，这款游戏都完全笼罩在神秘之中，而这让我非常想玩这款游戏。老实说，我原本期待会多次玩这款游戏，只是为了看看我还能让什么发生。本来可能会有那么多可能性，那么多结果，但你可以猜到，我最终极其失望。

《晚餐约会》实际上是什么样：

一段独白。这款游戏实际上就是一段伪装成电子游戏的独白。如果有任何大卫·凯奇的粉丝在读这段话，现在就买这款游戏。你在“等待”约会时做的任何事都无关紧要。我只玩了一次这款游戏，而且我进去时的意图是通过酗酒杀死我的角色，但即使我每5秒就灌下一杯酒，这个角色还是不停嘴……甚至在他喝酒的时候也是。你被迫听这个家伙哀嚎抱怨，而你对此无能为力。是的，有动作，但它们♥♥♥♥♥♥♥毫无意义。我很确定，如果一个人连续抽47根烟，他也许会在他的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥中间咳几下。游戏一直给我希望，让我觉得会发生什么好事。哦看！他站起来了！我能跳出窗户吗？不能。我能打开冰箱吗？不能。好吧，我能再拿起那瓶无穷无尽的酒吗？现在不行，不能。当我意识到我可以只是往后一靠，游戏就会自己玩下去时，我决定坚持到结尾，希望也许会发生什么有趣的事，但当然没有。你听这个家伙对生活哀嚎抱怨一阵子，然后就那样，游戏就结束了。他没有自杀（真遗憾），约会对象从未出现，什么♥♥♥♥♥♥♥都没发生。呃，这段体验最好的部分就是折磨很短。我这款游戏的游玩时间是23分钟，而且我一直等到片尾字幕结束。

所以就这样，我甚至无法把这款游戏推荐给喜欢独白或喜欢听悲伤……大概算是人生故事的人。与其浪费你的时间听这个家伙的问题，你不如去和你的朋友出去玩，也许帮他们解决他们的问题。我可以保证在那种情况下会有不同的结果和能产生影响的功能，我敢说，你试试一边像我在这个游戏里喝那么多酒，一边听你的朋友说话。换句话说，现实生活比《晚餐约会》更像电子游戏。

items.text:
Dinner Date is not a game. That is to say, loading it up and playing it doesn't expose you to anything you might consider gameplay. It is an intellectual experiment, trying to create art from a gaming perspective. Unfortunately what comes out is something that is so pretentious it seems to have been sucked through it's own rear end and into a completely different reality.

Now, if this was a free to download and try experiment at merging gaming and art I probably would be more positive towards it. But this is a priced experience, you don't simply get to try something new, you have to pay for it. And you don't get much for your money.

You play as Julian Luxemburg, or rather, as his subconscious as he sits around, nervously waiting for his date to arrive, you get to hear his inner monologue, fidget with the various items on the table and drum your fingers a bit. And that's really it, that's the entire experience. The subtle differences that can occur from taking different actions are so minute that it's hardly worth a second playthrough.

Only bright side to this experience is the above average voice acting of Julian but that alone doesn't add much.

All in all, this is quite simply a travesty. I am all for game developers experimenting and trying new things but when you are charging me money for 10 minutes of listening to someone worry about life that's just attempting to cash in on the bizarreness of your creation. Do not buy this, it is not worth your time and even if you're into this sort of art, there are much better experiences outside of the gaming medium.

《Dinner Date》不是一款游戏。也就是说，加载并游玩它并不会让你接触到任何你可能认为是玩法的东西。它是一个智力实验，试图从游戏的角度创造艺术。不幸的是，最终出来的东西是如此自命不凡，以至于它似乎被从自己的屁股里吸了进去，进入了一个完全不同的现实。

现在，如果这是一个可以免费下载并尝试的、融合游戏与艺术的实验，我可能会对它更积极一些。但这是一个需要付费的体验，你不能只是尝试某种新东西，你必须为它付钱。而你花这些钱得不到多少东西。

你扮演朱利安·卢森堡，或者更确切地说，扮演他的潜意识，他坐在那里，紧张地等待他的约会对象到来，你能听到他的内心独白，摆弄桌子上的各种物品，用手指敲一敲。真的就这些，这就是整个体验。采取不同行动可能产生的细微差别小到几乎不值得再玩一遍。

这个体验唯一的亮点是朱利安高于平均水平的配音，但仅凭这一点也加不了多少分。

总而言之，这简直是一场闹剧。我完全支持游戏开发者进行实验和尝试新事物，但当你为听某人担心生活10分钟而向我收费时，那只是在试图利用你作品的怪异性来捞钱。不要买这个，它不值得你花时间，即使你对这类艺术感兴趣，在游戏媒介之外也有好得多的体验。

The following paragraph is my recommendation for Painkiller: Black Edition, because, for some reason, Steam thinks I don't own that game, even though I ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ do. Like, I'm on the store page, and it doesn't even have that green section with the "play now" button. What the ♥♥♥♥. It's in my library. I bought the thing with money. Seriously, what the ♥♥♥♥.

Painkiller is a flawed game, but it is also hellishly fun. If you like fast-paced FPSs like Serious Sam, Doom or Quake, you'll dig this game. Big-ass levels with lots of variety, unique enemies and that special horror-y style. Also has unique guns, and all of them have alternate fires, like a shotgun that can freeze enemies or a sort of electric flamethrower... an electricitythrower... that shoots circular saw blade shuriken things! And you can click with both buttons to shoot one of the shuriken things that stays stuck to where it was fired while it is electrically charged and zaps multiple enemies around it. And a grenade launcher that is also a minigun. Hell yeah. Painkiller can be retarded hard and ridiculous sometimes, but it's just addictively fun. If it becomes too hard for you, you can just use cheats anyway. Sometimes it's funner that way too, just going kill crazy and blasting away like there's no tomorrow. The game also has some sort of... STORY. And a topless chick. Don't get the remake, Painkiller: Hell and Damnation, because they gave the topless chick a top. ♥♥♥♥ that. 0/10. Out of all the Painkillers to get into, the original right here should probably be your first choice.



The following paragraph is an anti-recommendation of Dinner Date, a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ game that I CAN write a recommendation for, but is not the slightest bit recommendable.

Dinner Date is a boring piece of ♥♥♥♥. It is hardly interactive at all, and what little possibility for player input there is is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ lame and inconsequential; all you can do is look in specific directions and make your ugly seemingly-autistic hands touch things a little bit. Then there's a part where your character actually gets off the damn seat, but then it is still boring and there is still nothing to do but listen to this guy be a negative nansy about stupid ♥♥♥♥ you don't care about. You can't really do anything as the player because you play as the character's subconscious. Oooooooh... Interesting concept, but it turns out it is not fun at all. Your character got stood up for a date, and he is alone at a dinner table at his house, and all there is to do is listen to this guy whine and wallow in his patheticness. Interesting idea, bad game. And if you want to call it "interactive art" instead of a proper "video game", it fails in that department too. And the graphics suck too. I honestly was looking forward to this game, cause it was a fascinating idea, but the game just sucks. It honestly just sucks. This is a sucky game, and it's not worth any amount of time or money, except for maybe as an example of how NOT to make a game.

Dinner Date's top key feature on its store page reads as follows: "Julian’s story lasts a fully voiced 25 minutes and is told through various unique animations, set in a real-time 3d environment with the unique interface of playing as a subconsciousness, the first of its kind."

25 whole minutes? 25 whole minutes?! 25 WHOLE MINUTES?! 25 WHOLE MINUTES, MAN! 25 whole minutes of SHEEYIT. And then you'll flush that ♥♥♥♥ down the toilet and forget about it. Or at least try to, because that was pretty traumatizingly nasty and painful ♥♥♥♥ to take.

The icon for this recommendation shows that of Dinner Date, but this is really a recommendation for Painkiller, and a word of warning for whoever might actually consider buying Dinner Date. Don't do it; Dinner Date is not fun at all. It's just trying to be artsy and intellectual and experimental, but it really just fails as a means of entertainment. This game was honestly just a disappointing waste of time, and I see nothing of value in this experience. Dinner Date can suck a ♥♥♥♥. Painkiller, however, is pretty damn enjoyable. Fun! Thrilling! Like any video game (or "interactive art") should be.


If you ever find yourself stuck in the perplexing dilemma of deciding whether to get Painkiller or Dinner Date, this is me telling you to get Painkiller.

以下段落是我对《Painkiller: Black Edition》的推荐，因为不知为何，Steam 认为我没有那款游戏，尽管我♥♥♥♥♥♥♥有。就像，我在商店页面上，它甚至没有那个带“立即游玩”按钮的绿色区域。搞什么♥♥♥♥。它就在我的库里。我花钱买的这东西。说真的，搞什么♥♥♥♥。

《Painkiller》是一款有缺陷的游戏，但它也极其好玩。如果你喜欢像《Serious Sam》、《Doom》或《Quake》这样快节奏的 FPS，你会喜欢这款游戏。超大的关卡，种类繁多，独特的敌人和那种特别的恐怖风格。还有独特的枪械，而且全都有副射击模式，比如一把能冻结敌人的霰弹枪，或者一种电火焰喷射器……电喷器……能射出圆锯刃手里剑之类的东西！而且你可以同时按两个键来射出一枚手里剑，它会粘在发射的位置，同时带电并电击周围多个敌人。还有一把榴弹发射器，同时也是转轮机枪。太棒了。Painkiller 有时会难得离谱、荒唐可笑，但就是让人上瘾地好玩。如果对你来说太难了，你反正可以用作弊码。有时候那样也更好玩，就是疯狂杀戮，像没有明天一样狂轰滥炸。游戏还有某种……剧情。还有一个袒胸露乳的妞。别买重制版《Painkiller: Hell and Damnation》，因为他们给那个袒胸露乳的妞穿上了上衣。去他妈的。0/10。在所有值得入坑的 Painkiller 中，这里的原版大概应该是你的首选。



以下段落是对《Dinner Date》的反推荐，这是一款♥♥♥♥♥♥游戏，我倒是能给它写推荐，但它一点也不值得推荐。

《Dinner Date》是一坨无聊的♥♥♥♥。它几乎毫无互动性，而仅有的一点玩家输入可能性也♥♥♥♥♥♥♥蹩脚且无关紧要；你所能做的就是朝特定方向看，让你那丑陋的、看似自闭的手稍微碰碰东西。然后有一段你的角色居然从该死的座位上站起来了，但之后还是很无聊，还是除了听这家伙对你根本不在乎的蠢♥♥♥♥抱怨个没完之外无事可做。作为玩家你其实什么也做不了，因为你扮演的是角色的潜意识。哦哦哦哦哦……有趣的概念，但结果一点也不好玩。你的角色被放鸽子了，他独自坐在自家餐桌旁，所能做的就是听这家伙哀嚎、沉溺于自己的可悲。有趣的想法，糟糕的游戏。如果你想把它称为“互动艺术”而不是正经的“电子游戏”，那它在这方面也不及格。而且画面也很烂。老实说，我本来很期待这款游戏，因为这是个迷人的想法，但这游戏就是烂。老实说就是烂。这是一款烂游戏，不值得花任何时间或金钱，也许除了作为如何不制作游戏的例子。

《Dinner Date》商店页面上最显眼的关键特性是这样写的：“朱利安的故事长达全程配音的 25 分钟，通过各种独特的动画讲述，设定在实时 3D 环境中，拥有扮演潜意识这一独特界面，同类首创。”

整整 25 分钟？整整 25 分钟？！整整 25 分钟？！整整 25 分钟，老兄！整整 25 分钟的狗屎。然后你会把那♥♥♥♥冲进马桶忘掉。或者至少试着忘掉，因为那真是相当
令人创伤般恶心又痛苦的♥♥♥♥，难以承受。

这个推荐的图标显示的是《Dinner Date》，但这实际上是对《Painkiller》的推荐，同时也是对任何可能真的考虑购买《Dinner Date》的人的警告。别买；《Dinner Date》一点都不好玩。它只是想装作文艺、知性和实验性，但作为娱乐手段，它真的完全失败了。老实说，这游戏只是令人失望地浪费时间，我在这段体验中看不到任何价值。《Dinner Date》可以去舔♥♥♥♥。然而，《Painkiller》却相当他妈的令人享受。好玩！刺激！就像任何电子游戏（或“互动艺术”）应该有的样子。


如果你曾经陷入那种令人困惑的两难境地，不知道该买《Painkiller》还是《Dinner Date》，这就是我在告诉你，买《Painkiller》。

items.text:
Qu'est-ce qu'un jeu vidéo ? Voila la réelle question que pose Dinner Date. La premiere réponse qui me vient à l'esprit est "pas ça".

Un jeu vidéo est-il le sens propre de "jeu" ? auquel cas, ce n'est pas ça, car je ne "joue" pas.

Un jeu vidéo est-elle une expérience interactive ? Auquel cas, ce n'est pas ça non plus, car je n'interagis pas.

Un jeu vidéo est-il une expérience à la première personne, ou l'on incarne le héros ? Auquel cas, ce n'est pas ça non plus, car nous incarnons le subconscient de Julian.

Un jeu vidéo raconte-t-il une histoire ? Auquel cas, ce n'est pas ça non plus, car il s'agit plus d'un morceau de vie que d'une histoire.

Un jeu vidéo est-il une forme de beauté visuelle ? Auquel cas, ce n'est pas ça non plus, car le jeu est laid et bugge parfois bien graphiquement.

Dans ce cas, qu'est ce qu'un jeu vidéo d'après Dinner Date ? C'est appuyer sur des boutons sans savoir ce que ça fait, c'est écouter un monologue long et rébarbatif d'une personne dont la vie est aussi intéressante que son monologue, dans un moment de sa vie des plus inintéressants. Dinner Date n'est même pas une mauvaise expérience ; ce n'est pas une expérience. On ressort de ce jeu sans opinions, sans sensations, sans avoir rien vécu et sans avoir rien fait.

Qu'est-ce qu'un jeu vidéo ? Ca n'est pas ça.
items.text_zh:
什么是电子游戏？这就是《Dinner Date》提出的真正问题。我脑海中浮现的第一个答案是“不是这个”。

电子游戏是“游戏”的字面意义吗？如果是这样，那就不是这个，因为我没有在“玩”。

电子游戏是一种互动体验吗？如果是这样，那也不是这个，因为我没有互动。

电子游戏是一种第一人称体验，我们扮演主角吗？如果是这样，那也不是这个，因为我们扮演的是朱利安的潜意识。

电子游戏会讲述一个故事吗？如果是这样，那也不是这个，因为它更像是一段生活片段，而不是一个故事。

电子游戏是一种视觉美的形式吗？如果是这样，那也不是这个，因为游戏很丑，而且有时在画面上还会出现明显的bug。

那么，根据《Dinner Date》，什么是电子游戏？就是按下按钮却不知道会有什么效果，就是听一个人冗长而令人厌烦的独白，而这个人的生活和他的独白一样无趣，而且是在他人生中最无趣的时刻之一。 《Dinner Date》甚至都不是一次糟糕的体验；它根本不是一次体验。人们从这个游戏里出来时没有观点，没有感觉，什么都没有经历过，也什么都没有做过。

什么是电子游戏？不是这个。

items.text: (...) Non consiglio questo gioco a nessun videogiocatore vero e proprio. Se cercate un gioco che risponda a tuti i crismi dell'ufficialità e che corrisponda alla definizione , questo non è un gioco. E' un viaggio nella mente di qualcuno, negli occhi di qualcuno, nella frustrazione quotidiana di qualcuno, nella vita di qualcuno. E ti fa riflettere su cosa fai quando pensi, quanto le frustrazioni e la quotidianità ti sappiano schiacciare anche e soprattutto perchè tu contribuisci a farlo con il tuo incessante rimuginio. Quanto il tuo problema sia fuori di te e quanto sia dentro, dovuto forse al fatto che neanche tu sai bene come sei, neanche tu sai bene cosa vuoi, neanche tu hai un'idea chiara, di niente. E ti salvi dandoti dello sfortunato o rovesciando la colpa su qualcun altro. O forse soltanto vivi senza scelte o temendo le scelte. Come gioco è pessimo, come storia è stranamente interessante. E' come stare dentro la testa di qualcuno. (...) (Rece completa sul mio sito)

items.text:
I recommend you AVOID this.  Basically, you get to listen to this annoying, unlikable guy complaining about how late his date is and why he even bothers for what feels like half an hour.  During this time, your "interactivity" is limited to pressing Q to look at the clock, E to look at the counter, and G to look at the table.

Then you hit points where they force you to do a particular action by taking away all other options.  You are forced to drink wine, forced to eat food, etc.  If you don't, you just sit at a static screen for years.  Basically, the game doesn't think about the player experience at all, and just wants to listen to itself talk.  

I have no idea why they wanted to make this interactive at all.  It's hard to believe they didn't have access to a video camera.  They obviously had a microphone to record the inane yammering of a *doosh.  Sell an MP3 if that's what you want to do.  Film it if you want to communicate his fidgeting.  Don't waste my time by making me press P.
items.text_zh:
我建议你避开这个。基本上，你得听这个烦人、不讨喜的家伙抱怨他的约会对象迟到多久，以及他到底为什么还要费这个劲，感觉像听了半个小时。在这段时间里，你的“互动性”仅限于按Q看时钟、按E看柜台、按G看桌子。

然后你会遇到一些节点，他们通过取消所有其他选项来强迫你做一个特定动作。你被迫喝葡萄酒，被迫吃东西，等等。如果你不照做，你就只能在一个静态画面上坐上好多年。基本上，这游戏完全不考虑玩家体验，只想听自己说话。
